reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts and is used by the client and server schedule code.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the amount rule stays in its single shared definition.

placement.why: The field is added in the API model mapper (scheduleModel.toExternal) where the API's external shape is built, with types in api-models/api-handlers.

scope.why: Only the mapper, its types and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Simple and clear; the separate APIScheduleListEntity type is reasonable, though toExternal itself now returns the list-only type, coupling the general mapper to the list output.
